solo-product-without-workspaces-01.graded_text: Journal data is owned by the user account directly, with no workspace, organization, team, or membership layer, and the auth provider's organization feature is not used.

votes.e: B/project/docs/architecture.md:9 "The application user is the ownership boundary. Every entry belongs directly to that user for its lifetime." and :11 "Do not create workspaces, organizations, memberships, invitations, roles, shared journals, tenant switchers, or personal-workspace wrappers. Do not enable Clerk Organizations." The data model agrees: :60 `entries` has "immutable `ownerUserId`" with no tenant column; :45 "No organization or separate account container is created."; :79 "These are fixed owner capabilities, not a configurable role or membership system."; :85 "no seats, team billing, organization payer". No code was changed (diff.txt holds only docs/architecture.md), so nothing shipped contradicts this.

solo-product-without-workspaces-02.graded_text: Signed-in routes are not nested under a workspace, organization, or account-scope segment.

votes.e: B/project/docs/architecture.md:97-108 route table lists only flat paths: `/`, `/auth`, `/today`, `/entries`, `/entries/:id`, `/search`, `/settings`, `/settings/account`, `/settings/journal`, `/settings/billing`. :112 "There is no `/u/:userId`, `/w/:workspaceId`, username path, date-based entry alias, or public share route." :11 "An account ID or workspace ID is unnecessary in routes: the verified identity supplies the account context." The closest any line comes to breaking it is the `app.<owned-domain>` origin at :93, which is a host, not a path segment for account scope. Checked B/project/docs/architecture.md and B/diff.txt; no other files changed.
